name: ynab
description: Connect YNAB to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use YNAB MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect YNAB to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with budget and spending review using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my YNAB workspace.
Find anything in YNAB that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review budget and spending review in YNAB.
